items.title: v0.40.16-rc0: Add ripple preview support to the MLX runner (#19592)
items.en_title: v0.40.16-rc0: Add ripple preview support to the MLX runner (#19592)
items.en_oneliner: This release adds the Ripple model to the MLX runner — model, renderer, parser, and import registration — plus fused MLP activation, value blending, and attention gating.

items.en_title: datasette #3046: Don't serve link: rel=next HTTP headers to Firefox for HTML pages

items.title: Terry Pratchett's Study
items.en_oneliner: A Hacker News comment on Terry Pratchett's study, reflecting on his idea of “horizontal wealth” — spending on things that make life interesting rather than rich-people status symbols.
